steps.en: OCMS receives warrant execution details from outside
steps.id: OCMS menerima detail eksekusi warrant dari pihak luar
steps.why_en: A general court update feed exists, but it carries no warrant execution details.
steps.why_id: Ada jalur update court umum, tetapi tidak membawa detail eksekusi warrant.

steps.en: OCMS stores the new court mention date
steps.id: OCMS menyimpan tanggal mention pengadilan yang baru
steps.why_en: No place exists to receive or store a new court mention date.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada tempat untuk menerima atau menyimpan tanggal mention baru.

steps.en: OCMS updates the processing stage of the notice
steps.why_en: The stage update works, but nothing is specific to executed warrants.
steps.why_id: Update tahap berjalan, tetapi tidak ada yang khusus untuk warrant yang dieksekusi.

steps.en: Officer can see that the warrant has been executed
steps.id: Officer bisa melihat bahwa warrant sudah dieksekusi
steps.why_en: No warrant-executed status exists in the system.
steps.why_id: Status warrant sudah dieksekusi tidak ada di sistem.
